inShort: A serves and calls a target while the ball is in the air. B has to return it there: line, middle or wide.
rules: A serves and is also the caller. B returns.
As the serve leaves A's paddle, A calls a target: "line" (down the line), "middle" or "wide" (out wide).
B returns to the called target. Hit it: B's point. Miss it: A's point.
Play to 11. Serve to both the right and the left side.
tooEasy: A calls later, as the ball crosses the net. Even harder: make the target zones smaller.
tooHard: A calls before serving, or make the target zones bigger.
goodLooksLike: B hits the called target more often than not, even when the call comes late.
